data.rationale: The proposal matches the true procedure (Planned Work, search route, select the suggestion, pick a date) with the right route and date parameters. It adds a "Select routes" click and a "read results" step that the true actions don't show, and it limits the scope to subway. The steps are concrete and every varying input is a named parameter, so a browser automation could be built from it.
